title: AI ‘slop’ is a social judgement
abstract: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02639-6 Artificial intelligence (AI)-generated content increasingly saturates our information environment. Efforts to detect and remove it are failing. We propose that calling AI-generated content ‘slop’ is best understood as a social judgement: what a community recognizes as unwanted AI content. Studying AI slop this way makes it tractable, measurable and governable.
